edits.name: rootTall
edits.prompt: Repaint the first image as a thick braid of old tree roots hanging straight down from a small grotto rock lip at the top, in exactly the hand-painted storybook style of the pieces in the second image: soft painterly gouache shading with gentle gradients, fine thin dark linework; the roots twisted and knobbly like the brown hanging roots in the second image, dark umber bark with paler worn ridges, a little soft grotto moss: three roots twisted round each other into one sturdy climbable column, knobbly bark knots along it, a few thin rootlets and thin streaks of soft moss, tapering to fine tips at the bottom. The stone lip at the top is dark cool grey-green grotto rock. Keep its shape and size. Keep the flat plain grey background around it, with empty grey space on every side.
